basics.name: Mahamat Nour Bachar Mahamat
basics.label: Data Scientist
basics.summary: Recent Data Science graduate interested in leveraging data to solve concrete challenges in industrial and scientific domains, with an approach combining innovation and meaningful impact.

work.name: IMT Atlantique/ENSTA, Brest
work.position: Research Intern - Marine Biodiversity Monitoring via Unsupervised Learning
work.summary: Development of underwater data analysis methods based on Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF).
highlights: Applied source separation techniques to bioacoustic recordings
Designed event detection pipeline for target sounds (e.g., whale songs) using NMF and ruptures
Explored innovative approaches in sequential learning and few-shot learning for bioacoustics

courses: Bayesian and Inferential Statistics & Time Series: theory and applications (Prophet, ARIMA, SARIMA)
Statistical Learning: theory and applications of supervised and unsupervised models
Introduction to Image Processing: classification, segmentation, object detection
Introduction to medical sciences, biology, engineering sciences and scientific methodology

references.name: Dr. Axel Marmoret
references.reference: Researcher – Lab-STICC (IMT Atlantique Brest). Internship supervisor: Passive acoustic monitoring project. Contact: axel.marmoret@imt-atlantique.fr

projects.name: ECG Signal Denoising
projects.summary: Personal project on denoising ECG signals.
highlights: Simulation of various physiological noises (Gaussian, electrode motion, muscle artifacts) on real ECG signals
Training a autoencoder/diffusion model and evaluation using MSE, SNR and correlation metrics

projects.name: Object Detection
projects.summary: Implementation of object detection pipelines using pre-trained and foundation models.
highlights: Implementation of object detection pipeline based on YOLOv11
Fine-tuning the YOLO-based model to improve detection on the MinneApple dataset
Comparative of performance between classic YOLO and the DINO foundation model

projects.name: Blood Cell Image Segmentation
projects.summary: Development of a segmentation pipeline comparing U-Net and VGG16 with transfer learning.
highlights: Development of a segmentation pipeline comparing a U-Net and a VGG16 using weight transfer (or transfer learning)
Use of data normalization and augmentation techniques to improve model generalization
Application of data augmentation and evaluation via Dice score and inverse IoU

projects.name: NLP: classification and content generation
projects.summary: Study of language models for supervised and generative NLP tasks.
highlights: Implementation of an article classification model (fake news vs. non–fake news)
Fine-tuning of an open model for article title generation based on content

projects.name: Diffusion Generative Models (Master's Thesis)
projects.summary: Study of mathematical foundations and practical implementations of diffusion models.
highlights: Study of mathematical foundations (SDE, time reversal) and implementation of practical applications
Comparative evaluation of diffusion models, GANs and VAEs on MNIST using the MML (Mean Max Logit) score
Critical analysis of strengths and limitations for synthetic data generation

projects.name: Predictive Analysis on Breast Cancer Genetic Data
projects.summary: Preprocessing and predictive modeling on gene expression data.
highlights: Preprocessing and normalization of gene expression data (GSE116 – GEO)
Selection of discriminant genes using statistical tests
Training and optimization of supervised models (logistic regression, SVM, random forests)

projects.name: Reinforcement Learning: DQN and PPO
projects.summary: Training agents on multiple environments and comparing algorithms.
highlights: Training agents on multiple environments (GridWorld, CartPole)
Comparison of DQN with and without Experience Replay (prioritized or not) and Target Network
Implementation of PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization) with adaptive KL cost

projects.name: Approximate Bayesian Computation with Random Forests (Master 1 Thesis)
projects.summary: Development of an ABC model based on random forests for model selection in population genetics.
highlights: Development of an ABC model based on random forests for model choice in population genetics
Performance evaluation on simulated data, then application to inference of Asian rice evolutionary history

projects.name: Database and Web Application – Enron Dataset
projects.summary: Data extraction and interactive web interface development.
highlights: Data extraction using regular expressions (regex) and populating a PostgreSQL database
Development of a web interface under Django for interactive visualization
